patternSummary.systematicEventLabel: Western intervals on attestations carry an outside-knowledge disclaimer in event text but still assert precise year endpoints while sourceDate.text is usually an office, kinship label, or personal name—not a calendar phrase from the cited unit.

correctionGroups.replacementRule: On each affected attestation: remove westernInterval (and westernYear if present); set undatedSourceAttestation: true; keep sourceDate.text as the Chinese anchor actually present in evidence; retain event wording that marks career/reign as biography-context only; do not treat active-date-hint ranges as if independently witnessed on the same claim.
correctionGroups.rationale: Cited units name offices or persons without reign-year material. Positive Western endpoints are extractor outside-knowledge estimates, not quotations or conversions supported by the cited Chinese.

correctionGroups.scope: Subset of G1 where evidence is rhetorical comparison only (e.g. p077–p079 on s0091)
correctionGroups.representativeZh: 且項羽、袁紹非不強也，高祖縞冠，人應如響；
correctionGroups.replacementRule: Same as G1 for the chapter cite; additionally mark that Western life ranges for these persons must come from accepted biography chapters or explicit undated allusion—never from the comparative sentence alone.
correctionGroups.rationale: Speech compares historical strength; it does not date Xiang Yu, Yuan Shao, or Gaozu within Jin annals.

correctionGroups.scope: 39 attestation items where cited Chinese contains a reign or era substring
correctionGroups.replacementRule: Do not auto-approve current Western intervals. After G1 repair, independently witness each row: map the cited era/reign phrase to Western bounds with documented conversion, or hold unresolved with specific reason.
correctionGroups.rationale: Calendar material appears in evidence, but present Western endpoints still use generic outside-knowledge conversion text and often mismatch the cited phrase (e.g. office string in sourceDate).

correctionGroups.replacementRule: Retain hints only as explicitly marked outside-knowledge until a date audit witnesses or unresolved each range. Hints must not duplicate approved Western attestations after G1 repair.
correctionGroups.rationale: Every local person carries an outside-knowledge hint; none are sealed by date-audits/jinshu/081.json.
